run_compute_vlb: run compute_vlb.py with hydra config to evaluate the variational lower bound on a pretrained diffusion model
run_calc_bpd_loop: run diffusion.calc_bpd_loop to compute bits per dimension metrics for a batch of images
run_plot_evolution: run plot_evolution to generate a chart showing metric terms across diffusion timesteps
run_setup_model: run setup to initialize the model, diffusion schedule, and dataloader from a hydra config
run_save_vlb_metrics: run the evaluation loop to save vb, mse, and xstart_mse terms as npz files with statistics
